Summary: LangGraph orchestration for the Megh One AI pipeline
Description: Move the whole question-answering pipeline (all six schemes, data and knowledge routes, context window, clarification pauses) onto a single LangGraph graph. Decisions D-032 (opt-in graph, 2026-10-02), D-036 (graph is the only orchestrator, 2026-10-06), D-037 (rephrase node, 2026-10-07). Docs: docs/LANGGRAPH_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/CONTEXT_AND_LANGGRAPH.md, docs/LANGGRAPH_PAUSE_RESUME.md, docs/LANGGRAPH_MIGRATION.md. Standing rule: logic lives in stage functions, never in a graph node; no second orchestration path.

Summary: Split the sequential pipeline into stage functions
Description: Split _run_pipeline, _answer_data and execute_with_repair verbatim into _turn_*_stage, _data_*_stage, _scheme_sql_rewrites, _execute_one_attempt, _repair_sql and _data_path_error_result so a graph and the old driver can call the same code. Behaviour unchanged (full suite identical before and after). Done 2026-10-02 (D-032).

Summary: Build the 21-node LangGraph graph over the stages
Description: app/pipeline_graph.py: nodes context, edge, followup, route, knowledge, data_context, scope_scheme, entities, clarification_gate, deterministic, sql_generate, authorize, execute_attempt, repair, post_rows, compose, guarantees, assemble, pause_gate, finalize, context_update. Explicit SQL repair loop, typed MeghalayaGraphState, per-node shape-only logs (pipeline_graph_node). Done 2026-10-02 (D-032).

Summary: Clarification pauses as interrupt() with checkpointing
Description: pause_gate node holds nothing but interrupt(); checkpoint under thread_id = session_id (SQLite by default, Postgres optional); the Session snapshot (D-023) stays the source of truth, the checkpoint holds only the paused execution. Pause sweeper started in main.py. Doc docs/LANGGRAPH_PAUSE_RESUME.md. Done 2026-10-02.

Summary: Run the conversation context window inside the graph
Description: Context, followup, data_context and context_update nodes carry the structured follow-up context (D-022/D-024) and session state for all six schemes; inheritance rules visible per node. Doc docs/CONTEXT_AND_LANGGRAPH.md. Done 2026-10-02.

Summary: Re-authorize every repaired SQL query (D-033)
Description: Each repair-model query passes auth.authorize after the deterministic rewrites and before execution; a denial ends the turn with the standard _denied result. Fixes KI-183. Done 2026-10-02.

Summary: Graph observability and performance measurement
Description: pipeline_graph_node and pipeline_graph_turn log lines (node, ms, outcome, path, resumed, repairs); offline orchestration-overhead benchmark recorded in docs/LANGGRAPH_MIGRATION.md section 4 and docs/LangGraph_vs_Context_Window_Benchmarks_2026-10-03.docx. Done 2026-10-03.

Summary: Cut over: LangGraph is the only orchestrator (D-036)
Description: Remove _run_pipeline, _answer_data, execute_with_repair, PIPELINE_GRAPH_ENABLED and PIPELINE_GRAPH_CANARY_PERCENT; answer_question always calls answer_question_via_graph. tests/_graph_turn.py replaces direct driver calls; test_the_graph_is_the_only_orchestrator guards the removal. Deploy .env files must drop the two removed keys. pytest 1,583 / 0. Done 2026-10-06.

Summary: Add the rephrase node for messy new questions (D-037)
Description: 22nd node rephrase between followup and route: typos, Hinglish, voice-to-text rewritten into one clean English question by the classifier model; _rephrase_violation rejects rewrites that change scheme, place, year, number or measure. Skipped for follow-ups and pause replies. tests/test_query_rephraser.py. Done 2026-10-07.

Summary: Restructure the pipeline into a package (common c01..c15 + one file per scheme)
Description: app/pipeline.py (18,700 lines) becomes app/pipeline/common/c01_followups.py .. c15_conversation_meta.py and app/pipeline/schemes/{mgnrega,pmay_g,focus_plus,cm_elevate,focus_legacy,cm_elevate_legacy}.py, loaded into one namespace by __init__.py. Behaviour-identical: pytest 2,372 / 0, scripts 14/14. Done 2026-10-15.

Summary: Graph tests and CI
Description: tests/test_pipeline_graph.py (node count pinned, every intermediate state serializes, each conversation repeats exactly on the graph with call counts asserted); bitbucket-pipelines.yml syntax gate and test sweep. Done 2026-10-08.

Summary: Fix the AI_PIPELINE model-roster documentation conflict
Description: docs/AI_PIPELINE.md classifier / verifier rows disagree with the 2026-10-15 fixed role map (4B router, 9B rewrite+composer, 30B schema-link/SQL/repair/verifier). Update the doc and CLAUDE.md section 5 to the role map. Open since 2026-10-18 (HANDOFF).

Summary: Commit and deploy the LangGraph-era code
Description: All work since 2026-10-13 is live-verified but uncommitted on the working tree. Reconcile the two parallel 2026-10-18 sessions (duplicate KI-309 row), commit, restart the deployed servers on port 8401 with the updated .env (SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=14400, SESSION_MAX_TURNS=50, READONLY_DATABASE_URL, no PIPELINE_GRAPH_* keys).

Summary: Context memory: forward and backward conversation memory
Description: Build complete context remembering per documents/MAIN_Contex.pdf (Context Memory proposal v1.0, phases P0..P6) and documents/Context_Memory_Forward_Backward_Review_v3.docx (WI-1..WI-9, S1, S4). Acceptance: review sections A forward, B out-of-context, C backward, D general, E hierarchy all pass through the HTTP API on port 8401. Decisions D-050, D-051, D-052. Built inside the context stage; the graph keeps its 22 nodes. Status 2026-10-18: all phases built and live-verified; WI-9 open.

Summary: P1/P2 Forward memory: topic switch and year handling (WI-1..WI-6)
Description: WI-1 a knowledge turn naming another scheme switches the topic (_switch_topic_on_knowledge); WI-2 a year is allowed in a measure after a knowledge answer; WI-3 verified; WI-4 'this year' takes the session year only on a follow-up; WI-5 context-built answers marked context_dependent and never cached by the router; WI-6 semantic cache hit must match scheme, place and year (scope_signature). Fixes KI-306. tests/test_forward_plan_wi.py. Done 2026-10-16.

Summary: P3 Backward memory: per-topic question ledger and resolver (D-050)
Description: app/topic_memory.py: each topic keeps a ledger of its last N questions with the ConversationState they ran in; resolve_turn restores by order ('the first question', 'question 3') or content (place, year, words); ambiguous matches ask with chips (ledger-ambiguous); 'what did we discuss?' answered as an aside. A ledger entry holds a scope, never a figure. Fixes KI-307. tests/test_topic_ledger.py (75). Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: P4 Constrained model pick for vague backward references
Description: A backward cue the rules cannot place ('that employment figure you gave earlier') goes to the 9B rewrite model with the last 3 turns and the numbered ledger; it answers one id, NONE or ASK, never writes a scheme, place or year. Flag LLM_REFERENCE_ENABLED, timeout 8 s. topic_memory.resolve_reference. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: P5 Place-level clearing and permissions on restore
Description: Setting a place level clears the levels below it deterministically in context_manager.update_state (a new district drops the old block and village). A restored question re-runs through the authorize node; denied turns are never stored in state or ledger. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: P6 Scope banner and 'Continue with ...?' after idle expiry
Description: _attach_scope_banner sets scope_banner on every DATA answer ('(from earlier)' on a restored turn); the React UI shows it above the answer and on thread reopen. Idle expiry sets the context aside (Session.expired_ctx); the first reply carries continue_offer; tapping restores state, topics and last turn. frontend Messages.jsx and chat.css rebuilt. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Stop, then 'continue' resumes the stopped question
Description: A cancelled streamed turn is kept on the session (Session.stopped_ctx, durable); the next 'continue' / 'resume' / 'go on' runs it through the whole layer, never cached; older than 30 min is dropped. UI mirrors it in frontend/src/chat/stopContinue.js. tests/test_stop_continue.py. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Longer memory window: 50 turns, 20 per topic, 4-hour idle (D-051)
Description: SESSION_MAX_TURNS 8 -> 50, CONTEXT_LEDGER_PER_TOPIC 6 -> 20, CONTEXT_IDLE_EXPIRY_SECONDS and SESSION_TTL_SECONDS 1800 -> 14400. Every deploy .env must carry 14400 / 50 (they override config.py). Done locally 2026-10-18; deploy .env update tracked in E1-12.

Summary: Conversation about the conversation: meta turns (D-052)
Description: app/pipeline/common/c15_conversation_meta.py, no model call: recap, explain (9B, grounded), misread (apology + ask), suggest (next questions), correction (drops the complaint lead, runs the follow-up), breakdown (previous question by district / block / village). Apology preface via _attach_preface in the finalize node; every meta reply is an aside. Also place overview -> scheme headline question, 'compare with last year' with no year asks which year, 'why is it so low?' -> reason. Fixes KI-310..312. tests/test_conversation_meta_2026_10_18.py. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Out-of-scope, refusal and denial asides; roll-up from the topic ledger
Description: Harmful refusals and denied follow-ups are asides so the topic survives them; 'back to the district level' / 'whole district' / 'statewide' becomes the topic's last aggregate question with the place rolled up (block -> parent district, village -> block, -> all of Meghalaya) from the durable ledger with a MergePlan that CLEARs the levels rolled past. Fixes KI-316. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: 'Compare with <scheme>' and mid-sentence comparison with an earlier figure
Description: _compare_with_scheme_question builds 'Compare <prev scheme> and <named scheme> in <place> in <FY>' for the deterministic cross-scheme path (D-044) instead of swapping schemes; conversation_layer.comparison_with_earlier handles 'how does this compare to MGNREGA?'. Fixes KI-320. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Cache-hit answers update the context state and carry the banner (KI-319)
Description: An answer served from the Redis / semantic cache skipped the graph so context_update never ran; now the structured state moves, the ledger entry has a scope and the idle 'Continue with ...' works after a cached answer. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Snapshot sync retry across workers (KI-314)
Description: When session_sync.sync_out failed (DB drop / VPN flap) the next request on another worker loaded a stale snapshot and answered in the wrong scope. Snapshot load / save now retried once. Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: 'Show me the districts, I will choose one' offers district chips (KI-317)
Description: After a data answer, a request to list places and pick one offers district chips (c14 step 0g, c05 _asks_to_pick_district / _pick_district_clarification); rephrase guard accepts contractions. Done 2026-10-18. Open question: offer blocks within a district the same way.

Summary: Fix the user's own UI thread losing context on follow-ups (KI-309, KI-308)
Description: KI-309: the 2026-10-18 UI conversation lost scheme / place on every follow-up; KI-308: guard / verifier ping-pong on a block follow-up ('What about Dalu block?'). CM Elevate and CM Elevate Legacy treated as one topic family (topic_memory.same_scheme_family). Done 2026-10-18.

Summary: Live context matrix: 7 flows x 6 schemes
Description: tests/live_context_matrix.py runs 42 live conversations (3 workers) against the running server; tests/live_context_validation.py scenarios F, U1, U2, N..R. 42/42 pass 2026-10-18. Run after every context change with the VPN up.

Summary: Conversation harness: YAML scenarios through the HTTP API
Description: tests/conversation_harness/ with YAML scenarios, checks (including a truth check against megh_db), http and in-process drivers and JSON reports in logs/conversation_harness/. 17/17 scenarios, 72/72 turns. First live run found KI-315 and a failed-turn rewrite bug, both fixed. Done 2026-10-18; add one scenario per reported bug.

Summary: Headless browser checks for banner, stop/continue, go back, history
Description: tests/ui_headless: scope banner, stop -> continue, go back, history at three widths (320 / 768 / 1440). Done 2026-10-18. Still unseen in a browser: the idle-expiry 'Continue with ...' chip.

Summary: Answer framing: every data answer reads as a briefing line (D-054)
Description: _framed_fallback / _finish_answer / _finish_data_result in c12 (finalize node) replace bare answers like '1,494,437 household years.' with scope, grouping and unit. Fixes KI-321, KI-322 part. Done 2026-10-19 morning.

Summary: Ask the financial year when neither question nor context has one (D-053)
Description: Fresh data question with no year pauses with the scheme's FY chips. Done 2026-10-19. Follow-up KI-324: the MGNREGA pause offers 'all of them combined' in words but has no chip and does not accept it typed.

Summary: WI-9 Qdrant search over archived turns on history cues
Description: Not built. The 8 topics x 20 questions ledger covers a session; WI-9 would search archived turns in Qdrant when a user refers to something older than the ledger. Needs the Qdrant API key from the infra team first. Decide with the product owner whether it is wanted.

Summary: Verify the idle-expiry 'Continue with ...' chip in a real browser
Description: Only part of P6 not yet seen in a browser (checked with a 60 s idle window headlessly). Run with the 4 h window shortened on a dev box and confirm the chip, the restore and the follow-up right after the tap.

Summary: KI-318 'go back to <place>' with a bare place name after the year moved
Description: 'go back to Mawphlang' after the topic moved to FY 2022-23 answered Mawphlang for the current year instead of the ledger's Mawphlang question (FY 2023-24). The backward cue with a bare place name must prefer the ledger entry. Open.

Summary: KI-324 MGNREGA year pause: 'all of them combined' chip and typed acceptance
Description: The D-053 MGNREGA year pause says 'a single financial year, or all of them combined?' but offers only four FY chips and re-asks when the combined option is typed. Focus Plus and CM Elevate Legacy pauses already have the chip. Also test_ki148 fails against the 6-option _scheme_clarification. Open.

Summary: KI-311 / KI-312 / KI-313 / KI-322 two-year, overview and verifier shapes
Description: KI-311 MGNREGA answers one year for a two-year block question and cannot break the two-fact compare down; KI-312 Focus Plus overview drops the amount; KI-313 eval MG-08 verifier false positive on a year range (c11 discard rule); KI-322 two statewide totals for 'beneficiaries' vs 'households employed' (SME to confirm MGNREGA beneficiaries = households). Open.

Description: Wire tests/conversation_harness (http driver) and tests/live_context_matrix.py into a scheduled run against the 8401 server with a report in logs/conversation_harness/. Open (HANDOFF 2026-10-18 evening).
